title: MEK-DarkGui
description: Added a dark-themed GUI texture for Mekanism's general machinery, compatible with versions 1.21.1 to 1.16.5
body:
This resource pack adds a dark UI for Mekanism's General Machines, addressing the lack of a new UI by emulating Applied Energistics 2's 1.21.1 GUI design, while also replacing the sound effects of the Chemical Injection Machine. 
Since Mekanism's UI is created by calling the same image to assemble the GUI, in
